flags.text: "Anchor assistant citations to matching titles in answer text with numbered badges and hover or keyboard-focus tooltips, retaining a sources list for unanchored citations." - Although #233 originally implemented this, #244 removed its AnswerCitationLayout and tests during integration, deferring inline badges. The shipped Markdown-based implementation was reintroduced separately in #245, so listing #233 as an added release feature misrepresents what survived integration.

"the assistant no longer claims a change succeeded unless a tool reports success, and it does not ask you to confirm a change you already requested. You can rely on its change claims being tied to a successful result in the conversation." - The PR added rules to the system prompt and verified specific live scenarios; it does not establish that the model will always follow them. The policy also permits confirmation for genuine user decisions, even when a change was requested.

"When an embedding is unavailable or fails, the check falls back to lexical scoring" - The facts specify fallback when there is no Voyage key or an embedding fails. They do not establish fallback whenever an embedding is otherwise unavailable.
